steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: 'Artificial Things' was choreographed by Lucy Bennett for Stopgap Dance Company and premiered in 2014 | Key Fact: Stopgap is an integrated dance company featuring both disabled and non-disabled dancers | Key Fact: The choreographic intention is to explore human connection and the idea of finding joy despite limitations | Key Fact: The work celebrates difference and shows how collaboration creates something greater than individual limitations

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from artificial things — lucy bennett, and one past-paper question.
